footer.about: A community organisation in Mirpur-13, Dhaka, working in education, healthcare and community building since 2019.

home.heroBody: Together, we can build a community where everyone has the opportunity to live with dignity, access essential support, and create a better future.
home.whoBody: Amrai Pari means “we can”. Started in 2019 by Sharmin Nasima Banu, the Foundation brings local people together to keep children learning, help families reach health care, and look after one another.
home.programsBody: Three areas of work, run by volunteers from the community.
home.eventsEmpty: No upcoming events right now. Follow us on Facebook for news.
home.helpBody: If you or your family need help with education, health or a difficult situation, tell us. Your request is seen only by authorised staff.
home.joinTitle: Give your time, skills or support
home.joinBody: Volunteer with us, support a program, or partner as an organisation.

about.title: About us
about.intro: Amrai Pari Foundation is a community-focused non-profit in Mirpur-13, Dhaka. Since 2019 we have worked in education, healthcare and community building.
about.storyFallback: The Foundation was started in 2019 by Sharmin Nasima Banu with a simple belief: everyone deserves a chance. It has grown into a team of more than ten permanent volunteers serving families in Mirpur-13.
about.registered: The Foundation is a registered organisation.

programs.title: Programs
programs.intro: Our work is organised into programs. Each one is run by volunteers who live in the community.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Specific pieces of work with a place, a time and a purpose.

impact.title: Impact
impact.intro: We only publish figures that have been checked by the Foundation, with their source and date.
impact.empty: Verified figures will appear here once the Foundation publishes them.

events.intro: Camps, drives, workshops and gatherings. Everyone is welcome.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.intro: Your support keeps our programs running. Please send contributions only to the official details below.
contribute.pending: Payment details will be published here once the Foundation confirms them. Until then, please contact us before sending any money.
contribute.safety: We will never ask for your PIN, OTP or card details. Report anyone who does.
contribute.otherWaysBody: Give your time as a volunteer, donate books or supplies, or partner with us as an organisation.
contribute.afterBody: Send us your name, amount and transaction ID through the contact form so we can acknowledge your contribution.

getInvolved.title: Get involved
getInvolved.intro: There is a place for everyone at Amrai Pari, whether you have an hour a week or an organisation behind you.
getInvolved.volunteerBody: Help at events, teach, organise health camps or support families.
getInvolved.partnerBody: Schools, clinics, businesses and other organisations can work with us.
getInvolved.contributeBody: Support our programs financially or with supplies.
getInvolved.step2: A coordinator calls you within a week.
getInvolved.step3: Join your first activity with the team.

privacy.heading: What we collect
privacy.body: When you fill in a form we store the details you give us, such as your name, phone number and message. We do not collect payment card details.

privacy.heading: How we use it
privacy.body: Only to respond to your request, organise volunteering and events, and keep records required to run the Foundation.

privacy.heading: Who can see it
privacy.body: Only Foundation staff who need it for their role. We do not sell or share your details with advertisers.

privacy.heading: Your choices
privacy.body: Contact us to see, correct or delete the details we hold about you.

privacy.heading: Photos
privacy.body: We publish photos of identifiable people only with their consent, or a guardian's consent for children.

terms.heading: Using this website
terms.body: By using this website you agree to these terms. The content is provided to inform the public about the Foundation's work.

terms.heading: Contributions
terms.body: Contributions are voluntary. Send money only to the official details on the Contribute page. The Foundation is not responsible for money sent elsewhere.

terms.heading: Requests for assistance
terms.body: Submitting a request does not guarantee support. Decisions depend on need and available resources.

terms.heading: Content
terms.body: Text, photos and the logo belong to Amrai Pari Foundation unless stated otherwise. Please ask before reusing them.

terms.heading: Changes
terms.body: We may update these terms. The latest version is always on this page.
